project_objective: Construct a unified spin-1 deuteron partonic framework in which quark and gluon light-front GTMD correlators generate TMD, GPD, PDF, Wigner, local-current, and observable reductions, while developing a regulated microscopic light-front Hamiltonian/current whose resolution-local parameters can eventually be physically identified and connected to the same correlator layer.

claim_lanes.exploratory: Explicit assumptions and provisional parameters are allowed; outputs are not physical predictions.
claim_lanes.validated_model: Requires coherent equations, units, direct tests, declared conventions, qualified controlling inputs, and sensitivity checks.
claim_lanes.physical_claim: Requires source-qualified state/current/input definitions, covariance ownership, resolution checks, and a reproducible end-to-end calculation.

equation_authority_classes: exact consequence of declared convention or algebra
project-convention identity defining the executable representation
literature factorization relation with stated domain and scheme

complete_within_declared_basis: 18-function leading-twist quark or antiquark TMD projection basis

resolved proton/neutron, flavor, spin, link, mechanism, and uncertainty composition architecture
operational_but_heterogeneous: selected inclusive, SIDIS-kernel, elastic, and Wigner observables
one-loop/intermediate TMD evolution and channel-specific matching interfaces
not_complete: general nonzero-skewness spin-1 GTMD independent-amplitude decomposition and polynomiality program
uniform production-ready rank-aware TMD evolution for all channels
complete numerical reproduction of the 2026 T-even or T-odd deuteron gluon spectator models
physically identified microscopic Hamiltonian, deuteron state, production current, fit, response rank, or activation

conventions.finite_cell_mass_conversion: delta M^2 = (2*pi*K/L) delta P^- = (4*pi*K/ell_-) delta P^-
conventions.resolution_label: K2 = 2K; labels K9, K11, K13 store K2 values 9, 11, 13
conventions.gtmd_imaging_fourier: rho(b_Delta) = integral d^2Delta/(2*pi)^2 exp(-i Delta.b_Delta) W(Delta)
conventions.tmd_evolution_fourier: F_tilde(b_T) = integral d^2k_T exp(+i b_T.k_T) F(k_T)
conventions.charge_radius_GeV_to_fm: r_D^2[fm^2] = -6*(hbar*c)^2*dG_C/dQ^2 at Q^2=0 when Q^2 is in GeV^2
conventions.quark_helicity_alias: g_1 is identical to g_1L in the declared project/literature notation
